translations.web: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.
translations.bsb: And we have confidence in the Lord that you are doing and will continue to do what we command.
translations.kjv: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.
